_: Editorial for polo-shadow. Fabric, fit, size guide, marquee, closing CTA and cross-sell come from _family-polo-classic.json.
_specs: The design name comes from the Shopify image filename, the only record of what the print is. Nothing about the artwork is invented.
buyBody: Grey camo, built out of four-leaf clovers. You have to be close to see what the pattern is actually made of, which is most of the fun of it.
pieceParas: From any distance it is a grey camouflage print. Up close the shapes resolve into four-leaf clovers, which is the sort of detail that only pays off for the person standing next to you on the tee.
Grey is the most wearable thing in the range. It goes with every colour of trouser anyone actually owns, and it hides a round better than white does.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body. Needs one close crop as a second frame — the clover reveal is the entire idea and it is invisible at full-body distance. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
